note: Opt-out pages move. Links have not been checked online for this version; each entry also names the site so the person can find its privacy page.

brokers.name: Spokeo
steps: Find your listing and copy its address.
Paste it on the opt-out page with an email address.
Open the confirmation link they send.

brokers.name: Whitepages
steps: Paste the address of your listing.
Confirm with the automated phone call and its code.

brokers.name: BeenVerified
steps: Search for your name and state.
Choose your record and give an email address.
Open the confirmation link.

brokers.name: Intelius, TruthFinder, Instant Checkmate (PeopleConnect)
steps: Sign in with an email address and the code they send.
Find and suppress each of your records.

brokers.name: PeopleFinders
steps: Search for your record.
Request removal and confirm by email.

brokers.name: Radaris
steps: Find your profile and choose to control it.
Ask for the information to be hidden.

brokers.name: FastPeopleSearch
steps: Find your record and choose removal.
Confirm by email.

brokers.name: TruePeopleSearch
steps: Find your record and choose removal.
Confirm by email.

brokers.name: USPhoneBook
steps: Find your listing.
Request removal and confirm by email.

brokers.name: Acxiom
steps: Fill in the opt-out form for marketing data.
Confirm by email.
In the EU or UK you can also send the erasure request below.

brokers.name: LexisNexis Risk Solutions
steps: Fill in the opt-out request.
They may ask for proof of identity; send only what the form asks for.

brokers.name: Epsilon
steps: Send a data subject request for deletion.
Confirm by email.

brokers.name: Experian Marketing Services
steps: Use the marketing opt-out form (not the credit report).
Keep the reference number.

gdpr.subject: Erasure request under Article 17 GDPR / UK GDPR

ccpa.subject: Request to delete and not sell or share my personal information (CCPA/CPRA)

pdpl.subject: Request to erase my personal data
